definitions.explanation: The act of buying and selling goods, or running a business. A somewhat traditional word that conveys the spirit of Japanese merchant culture.

examples.japanese: {商|あきな}い⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{信用|しんよう}→信用：03267_shinyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧{商|あきな}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧てきた。
examples.english: My grandfather has been in business for many years.

examples.japanese: {商|あきな}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{基本|きほん}→基本：00226_kihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}って→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧ことだ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{教|おし}えられた→教える：00526_oshieru⟧。
examples.english: I was taught that the basics of business are thinking from the customer's perspective.

notes:
USAGE:
A traditional word with roots in Japanese merchant culture. Carries a warmer, more personal nuance than the modern ⟦ビジネス→ビジネス：11162_bijinesu⟧ or ⟦{商売|しょうばい}→商売：03239_shoubai⟧. Often associated with small, family-run shops and traditional commerce. The proverb {商|あきな}い⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{牛|うし}→牛：01857_ushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{涎|よだれ} (business is like a cow's drool — slow and steady wins) reflects the patient approach to trade this word evokes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {商|あきな}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to do business)
- {商|あきな}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{上手|うま}い (to be good at business)
- {商|あきな}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧ (the way of commerce)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{商売|しょうばい}→商売：03239_shoubai⟧: business, trade — more common in everyday speech
- ⟦ビジネス→ビジネス：11162_bijinesu⟧: business — modern, Western-influenced term
